properties.nhcTitle: East of the Leeward Islands (Remnants of Dolly)
properties.discussion:
Disorganized showers and thunderstorm continue in association with  the remnants of Tropical Storm Dolly, located about 300 miles east  of the Leeward Islands. However, there are no signs that the system  is developing a closed circulation. Redevelopment of this system is  unlikely while it moves westward to west-northwestward near 25 mph.  The wave could bring locally heavy rains and gusty winds to  portions of the Leeward Islands, the Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico  over the next several days. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...10 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Northeastern and North-Central Gulf of America
properties.discussion:
Cloudiness and showers associated with a weak low pressure area  centered about 125 miles south of Pensacola, Florida, have become a  little better organized since yesterday.  Some additional slow  development of this system is possible during the next few days as  it drifts westward. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

An area of disturbed weather, associated with a tropical wave, is  located well to the south of southwestern Mexico. This system is  expected to move west-northwestward to northwestward at 10 to 15  mph. Environmental conditions appear favorable for gradual  development of this system, and a tropical depression is likely to  form in the next several of days. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...40 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

An area of low pressure could form well south or southwest of the  Hawaiian Islands in the next few days. Some gradual development is  possible thereafter and a tropical depression could form during the  middle part of next week. The system should move slowly  west-northwestward, and stay well offshore of the Hawaiian Islands. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...40 percent.
